archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON x NORTHEASTERN SERTÃO CULTURA

brand_identity.name: SertãoCast
brand_identity.tagline: A voz do Sertão na velocidade do streaming
brand_identity.logo_concept: Cactus-themed podcast microphone with neon green (#4ade80) speech bubble vibe on deep obsidian background.
brand_identity.vibe: Energetic, cultural, bold, modern, authentic Northeastern Brazilian soul meets high-tech podcast studio.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_grid.hero_layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid with Neon Glow microphone visual, live audio visualizer widget, quick stats, and primary booking CTA.
layout_and_grid.episodes_grid: 3-column responsive bento cards with neon hover outline, play button overlay, duration badge, and category tags.
layout_and_grid.booking_layout: Step-by-step interactive studio reservation flow: 1. Date & Time Selection, 2. Studio Spec / Equipment Add-ons, 3. User & Podcast Info, 4. Auto-Approval Confirmation Screen.
layout_and_grid.admin_layout: High-density command center dark dashboard with sidebar navigation, metric cards, interactive bookings table, and episode manager modal.

components_to_build.Navbar: Sticky header with glassmorphism blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070A07]/80), glowing SertãoCast logo badge, nav links (Home, Episódios, Sobre, Agendar Sala, Contato, Admin), live 'AO VIVO / NO AR' neon pulse tag, and 'Agendar Agora' button.
components_to_build.HeroSection: Dynamic headline 'Cultura, Humor, Música & Conversa Sem Filtro', interactive mini-player audio widget, CTA buttons with glowing borders, and cactus-mic background graphics.
components_to_build.AudioPlayerBar: Sticky or expandable floating bottom audio player with play/pause, scrub bar, volume, speed control, episode cover thumbnail, and audio visualization bars.
components_to_build.EpisodeCard: Card with category tag (Cultura, Música, Humor, Entrevistas), host tags, play count, release date, quick-listen play button, and share modal.
components_to_build.BookingCalendar: Interactive visual calendar picker for selecting studio dates and time slots (08:00 to 22:00), equipment options (Røde mics, 4K cameras, multi-track mixing, video podcast lighting), price calculation, and instant auto-approval simulation.
components_to_build.AdminDashboard: Protected/simulated admin panel with login screen, tabs for 'Agendamentos' (approve, cancel, filter by date), 'Episódios' (create new episode, upload thumbnail, edit title/description/audio link), and 'Métricas' (total streams, booked hours, estimated revenue).
components_to_build.AboutSection: Sertão identity narrative, host profile spotlight cards, studio photos gallery, and hardware setup list (Microfones Shure SM7B, Câmeras Sony Alpha, Mesa Rødecaster Pro II).
components_to_build.ContactForm: Form with neon validation states, dynamic topic selector, interactive FAQ accordion, and WhatsApp/Instagram quick links.

data_testid_rules.requirement: ALL interactive components, buttons, form inputs, audio controls, tab buttons, admin actions, and calendar slots MUST include clear data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete hybrid web application for SertãoCast in Portuguese (PT-BR).
Ensure the visual tone perfectly reflects Sertão + Cyberpunk Streaming: Deep dark background (#070A07) with glowing neon green (#4ade80) and cyan (#06b6d4) accents.
Include full navigation routing or tab views for: Home, Episódios, Sobre, Agendar Sala, Contato, Admin Login & Admin Dashboard.

Provide interactive features: Audio player bar with live episode playback simulation, audio wave visualization, booking calendar with time slots and instant approval confirmation, filters and search for episodes, and full admin management controls.
Use Lucide-react icons, Framer Motion for neon glow transitions, and Sonner for toast notifications.
Make sure every interactive element contains the required data-testid attributes.
